description: A chunky low-poly main battle tank parked on the ground, seen from the front-left, built with many small separate faceted parts like a detailed game unit. A long low angular hull with a sloped front glacis plate, two small tow hooks and two square headlights inside small cage guards on the front edge of the glacis, a flat track guard shelf over each track with no side skirt, and a flat engine deck at the rear with two raised rectangular grille boxes made of parallel slats. A wide flat-sided angular turret sitting slightly behind the middle of the hull with a sloped front face and a thick mantlet block; a long thick main gun barrel pointing straight forward over the nose with a short fume-extractor bulge halfway along it and a short muzzle collar at the tip. On the turret roof's right half a raised round commander's cupola with a hinged hatch lid and small vision blocks around it, and a short machine gun on a pintle beside the cupola; on the turret roof's left half a flat square loader's hatch. A cluster of four short smoke-grenade launcher tubes on each front corner of the turret, angled forward and up. Along each side a full-length track loop of clearly separate segmented track links, running over seven large road wheels each with a raised round hub cap, three small return rollers along the top run of the track, a toothed drive sprocket at the rear end and a smooth idler wheel at the front end, all clearly visible below the track guard. Hull, turret, cupola, hatches, track guards and grille boxes painted one olive drab green; gun barrel, mantlet, machine gun, smoke launchers, tow hooks, headlight guards, tracks, road wheels, return rollers, sprockets and idlers dark gunmetal grey, hub caps a slightly lighter grey; headlight lenses pale grey. The engine exhaust grille on the rear face and the stowage basket on the back of the turret face away and are hidden; the right-hand track and right-hand smoke launchers are hidden behind the hull and turret.
proportions: About 9.5 m long including the gun, 3.6 m wide and 2.5 m tall; the seven road wheels, return rollers and track links clearly visible; the whole tank drawn small enough that the gun muzzle and the track ends stay well inside the frame with a wide white margin on all four sides. (length : width : height = 2.64 : 1 : 0.69)
sides: the main battle tank is symmetric left to right except the turret roof: the raised round commander's cupola with the pintle machine gun beside it sits on the turret roof's RIGHT half, the flat square loader's hatch on its LEFT half; the gun points straight forward on the centre line. Seven road wheels per side, no side skirt.
